referenceSources.title: 5 of the Rarest, Most Impressive Lotus Esprit Editions - autoevolution
referenceSources.description:
A striking yellow Lotus Esprit Sport 300 stands on a gravel clearing, framed by dry grass and dense trees. The rear three-quarter view highlights its aerodynamic rear wing, dual exhaust pipes, and wide five-spoke alloy wheels. A French license plate, EJ-397-YS, is mounted between the rectangular taillights, and a green “300 Sport” decal marks its limited-edition status.

This photograph accompanies an autoevolution feature on the rarest Lotus Esprit editions. The Sport 300 was introduced in 1992 as a homologation special for European GT racing, boasting a reinforced chassis, motorsport-derived suspension, and a turbocharged 2.2-liter engine producing 302 hp. Only 64 units were built, making it one of the most sought-after Esprit variants among collectors.
